heading.en: The security guard of your computer

hook.en: A security guard checks faces against a list of known troublemakers, but also watches anyone who behaves suspiciously. A good antivirus does both.
hook.kn: ಭದ್ರತಾ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಗೊತ್ತಿರುವ ತೊಂದರೆಕೋರರ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮುಖಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅನುಮಾನಾಸ್ಪದವಾಗಿ ವರ್ತಿಸುವವರನ್ನೂ ಗಮನಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಆಂಟಿವೈರಸ್ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe signature, sandbox, heuristic and real-time methods
Explain spam and how to deal with it

narration.en: A security guard checks faces against a list of known troublemakers, but also watches anyone who behaves suspiciously. A good antivirus does both.
narration.kn: ಭದ್ರತಾ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಗೊತ್ತಿರುವ ತೊಂದರೆಕೋರರ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮುಖಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅನುಮಾನಾಸ್ಪದವಾಗಿ ವರ್ತಿಸುವವರನ್ನೂ ಗಮನಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಆಂಟಿವೈರಸ್ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: An antivirus is software that detects malware, prevents it from running and removes it. Its main methods are: signature-based detection, which compares files with a database of known malware patterns (virus definitions) and so must be updated often; sandbox detection, which runs a suspicious program in an isolated virtual environment and watches what it does; heuristic and data-mining techniques, which flag code or behaviour that looks like malware even without a known signature; and real-time protection, which scans files the moment they are opened, downloaded or copied.

points.en: Signature-based: match known patterns; keep definitions updated
Sandbox: run in isolation and watch
Heuristics / data mining: spot suspicious features

narration.en: An antivirus is software that detects malware, prevents it from running and removes it. Its main methods are: signature-based detection, which compares files with a database of known malware patterns (virus definitions) and so must be updated often; sandbox detection, which runs a suspicious program in an isolated virtual environment and watches what it does; heuristic and data-mining techniques, which flag code or behaviour that looks like malware even without a known signature; and real-time protection, which scans files the moment they are opened, downloaded or copied.
narration.kn: ಆಂಟಿವೈರಸ್ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿ ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಹಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಪತ್ತೆ, ಸ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಬಾಕ್ಸ್, ಹ್ಯೂರಿಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ನೈಜ ಸಮಯದ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಇದರ ಮುಖ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: Inside an antivirus scan

say.en: A new file arrives, say from a download.

text.en: How an antivirus checks a file

say.en: First, its pattern is compared with the signature database. A match means known malware.
No match? It may be new malware. Heuristics and a sandbox watch how it behaves.
If it behaves normally, the file is allowed. Real-time protection keeps checking files as they are opened.

narration.en: We follow one file through the checks of an antivirus.

body.en: Spam is unsolicited, usually bulk, electronic messages, most often email, sent to many people for advertising, fraud or to spread malware and phishing links. It wastes time, storage and network bandwidth. Email services use spam filters to move such mail to a spam folder. Users should not open suspicious attachments or click links in spam, should not reply to it, and should not share their email address publicly without need.

points.en: May carry malware or phishing links
Use spam filters; do not reply or click

narration.kn: ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾಮ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಅನಪೇಕ್ಷಿತ ಬೃಹತ್ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳು. ಇವು ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಅಥವಾ ಮೋಸದ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಹೊತ್ತಿರಬಹುದು. ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾಮ್ ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಬಳಸಿ, ಉತ್ತರಿಸಬೇಡಿ, ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ.

problem.en: An email says: "Congratulations! You have won ₹10 lakh in a lucky draw. Download the attached form Claim.exe and send your bank details within 24 hours." List the warning signs and the right action.

steps.en: Unknown sender and a prize you never entered for → spam/fraud
Urgency ("within 24 hours") to stop you thinking
An attachment ending in .exe can run malware; never open it
It asks for bank details, which genuine organisations never request by email
Action: do not reply or click; mark as spam and delete

answer.en: It is spam (a phishing attempt carrying a possible Trojan): mark it as spam and delete it without opening the attachment.

narration.en: Look for the unknown sender, the urgency, the executable attachment and the request for bank details.

problem.en: Which antivirus method catches each case? (a) A file matches the pattern of a virus first seen last year. (b) A brand-new program tries to encrypt hundreds of files in a test environment. (c) A file copied from a pen drive is scanned the moment it is opened.

steps.en: (a) Known pattern in the database → signature-based detection
(b) Behaviour watched in an isolated environment → sandbox detection

narration.en: Match each case to the question: known pattern, watched behaviour, or scanned on access?
Team quiz. Each team agrees on one answer before the timer runs out.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಸಮಯ ಮುಗಿಯುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿ.

narration.en: CBSE pattern: assertion–reason and case-based questions. Read the case carefully before you answer.
Board exam pattern questions. Read every option before you choose.

points.en: An antivirus detects, blocks and removes malware.
Signature-based detection needs regularly updated definitions.
points.kn: ಸಹಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಪತ್ತೆಗೆ ನಿಯಮಿತವಾಗಿ ನವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಗಳು ಬೇಕು.

points.en: Sandbox and heuristics catch new, unknown malware.
points.kn: ಸ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಬಾಕ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹ್ಯೂರಿಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಹೊಸ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Spam is unwanted bulk messaging; never click its links.
points.kn: ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾಮ್ ಅನಪೇಕ್ಷಿತ ಬೃಹತ್ ಸಂದೇಶ; ಅದರ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ.

homework.en: Open the spam folder of an email account (with permission) and list three warning signs you find in the messages.

narration.en: Recap. An antivirus detects, blocks and removes malware. Signature-based detection needs regularly updated definitions. Sandbox and heuristics catch new, unknown malware. Spam is unwanted bulk messaging; never click its links.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವಲೋಕನ. ಆಂಟಿವೈರಸ್ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿ, ತಡೆದು, ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಹಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಪತ್ತೆಗೆ ನಿಯಮಿತವಾಗಿ ನವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಗಳು ಬೇಕು. ಸ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಬಾಕ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹ್ಯೂರಿಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಹೊಸ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾಮ್ ಅನಪೇಕ್ಷಿತ ಬೃಹತ್ ಸಂದೇಶ; ಅದರ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ.
